text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Manhattan Cafe holding her head
in her hands in the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Um... Trainer...?
Would it be okay if I... stayed with you for a little while...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Whenever these headaches start... "they" around me...
begin to get restless...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...If anything happened to you, Trainer... I-I'd hate it..."
While I appreciated her concern, I was far more worried about her headache...
